Name: Custom Farmer Portraits
Author: AstaEckhart
Description:
[center]I don’t have much experience making content packs, and I’m incredibly grateful to [b]Mistyspring[/b] for allowing me to reference their example pack! Without them, I wouldn’t have been able to complete this project!


[b][size=5]All the images created for this mod are my own work.[/size]

[size=4]You are free to recolor them for personal use, but please do not re-upload, claim, or mislead others into thinking you are the creator.If you share these portraits on other websites, please credit the original source![/size][/b]



[b]Below are all the images included in this mod, allowing you to customize your farmer portrait as you like.
[/b]
[size=4][b][size=5]◆ [b]1.3 new[/b] ◆
[/size][/b][/size][size=2]Added a Masculine style and 3 optional reaction,Added flipped versions for all side front hairstyles,Separated FaceAcc from the Detail section, so you can now have earrings and scars simultaneously.

[b][size=5]◇ How to use
[/size][/b]
1. Download [b]Farmer Portraits 1.6 [/b]and[b] Generic Mod Config Menu[/b]
2. Place my content pack in the mod folder (path: \Mods)
3. Finish!

[b][size=3]There are two ways to change your portrait:
[/size][/b]
1. On the main menu, click the gear icon in the bottom left corner and find [b]Custom Farmer Portraits

[/b][img]https://i.imgur.com/Na7Xqwn.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/rLFXWsV.png[/img]


2. While in-game, open the menu and go to the [b]MOD options[/b] to find [b]Custom Farmer Portraits[/b].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/uh3zJRe.png[/img]


Whichever method you choose, you’ll see the following screen, where you can freely customize your portrait and select different outfits for each season and holiday!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/YlR2ArD.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/pS83Rlt.png[/img]
[b]
＊Make sure the "UseCustomPortrait"and "PortraitReactions" in the FarmerPortraits folder is set to true (Path: \Mods\FarmerPortraits\config.json)
＊Make sure not to install any other farmer portrait CP files besides mine (the optional files for FarmerPortraits are not needed either).[/b]

[b][size=5]Then, enjoy the game![/size][/b]
